final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT z.city, COUNT(*) AS attendees FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), city_shares AS (SELECT city, attendees, 1.0 * attendees / SUM(attendees) OVER () AS share FROM city_counts), averages AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM city_shares) SELECT AVG(attendees) AS avg_attendees, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM averages)) AS avg_excess_share FROM city_shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM averages)
